protocol: 400 test worlds, 50 per family. Overall rows: equal-world means with a world bootstrap (seed 42, 10,000 draws); family rows: the same bootstrap inside one family; contrasts: paired bootstrap resampling worlds within each family, equal-family mean. Category F1 and Entity F1 are reported separately and never combined. A world with no answer scores as unresolved singletons and stays in the denominator.
